title: Appeal 20248: fire rating by interior gypsum for a converted garage wall 1 foot 4 inches from a property line
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record

facts.text: Appeal item: R302 fire-resistant construction for walls less than 3 feet from a property line; the western wall is 1 foot 4 inches from the line with no eave; the garage was converted to living space before the current owner.
Proposal: two layers of 5/8-inch fire-rated gypsum on the interior face of the studs instead of removing siding; the applicant says removing siding would be more difficult and costly.

Decision: alternate one-hour assembly for the west wall is granted provided two layers of Type X gypsum, blocking to roof sheathing, no openings within 3 feet, roof-underside gypsum, and no built elements crossing the line.
